description: The board's data streams (telemetry, logs, errors, events, user streams): each one way, OUT (the board sends) or IN (what comes in on its providers), to one list of targets: providers, subscribed peers, the board's own callbacks.

commands.label: Create a stream
commands.description: Creates a user stream: its byte and its direction, set for good. A device both ways is two streams.

fields.label: Stream
fields.description: The new stream: 0x01..0x7F, not one that exists (0x80 and more are the session's channels)

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Out: the board sends to it; In: what comes in on its providers

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: SYS_STREAM_FLAG_URGENT: its frames go first on every way out

commands.label: Remove a stream
commands.description: Removes a user stream and its targets; its providers are free again.

commands.label: Bind to a provider
commands.description: Binds a stream to a provider (a BLE characteristic, a UART port): an Out stream sends its payloads there as they are, an In stream takes what comes in there and is the one that reads from it.

commands.label: Add an output
commands.description: A way out of an In stream: what comes in on its bindings goes to this provider as it is. A tunnel between two providers is two In streams, one each way. An Out stream refuses it: its bindings are its way out.

commands.label: Send to another board
commands.description: A provider of another board, or a client's receiver, as a target of the stream: each message goes there and that board sends it on the provider as it is. It stays when that board is gone.

fields.label: Board
fields.description: The board or client it goes to, not this board

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The provider's id on that board; for a client, its receiver

commands.label: Unbind from a provider
commands.description: Removes the stream's binding, output or remote target of this provider (on any board).

commands.label: Unbind everything
commands.description: Removes every binding, output and remote target of the stream.

commands.label: List the streams
commands.description: Returns every stream, its state and its targets.

returns.label: Number of streams
returns.description: Then, per stream: its head (id, direction, flags, state, target count), then its targets (type u8, peer u8, provider u8, dropped u16).

commands.label: Subscribe to a stream
commands.description: The peer that sends it gets the stream's messages, [stream id][payload] in a PUSH frame, until UNSUBSCRIBE or its session ends.

commands.label: Unsubscribe from a stream
commands.description: Ends the subscription of the peer that sends it.
